patterns.note: Asymmetrical, staggered grid layout for project showcases, creating visual interest and dynamic flow.
Dominant use of a very large, light-weight, uppercase sans-serif font for the hero statement, contrasting with smaller, regular-weight text for navigation and content labels.
High-contrast color scheme featuring a light, off-white background, dark grey/black content blocks and text, and a very light (white) hero text.
The hero text features a dynamic word-swapping animation, where specific words within the main statement cycle through different terms as the user views the page.
Content blocks and sections appear to reveal or fade in as the user scrolls down the page, creating a staggered entry effect.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a dynamic text animation, likely using JavaScript or a text animation library, to cycle through different words within a prominent headline, creating an engaging and evolving message.
Content sections and individual project cards are introduced with scroll-triggered reveal animations, such as a subtle fade-in or slide-up, as they enter the viewport, enhancing visual engagement.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, ensuring persistent access to site links as the user scrolls through the content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, light-weight, uppercase hero text (~4-5x body) with smaller, regular-weight uppercase labels and body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners predominantly, especially on content blocks and interactive elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy and open, particularly in the hero section and between content blocks, creating a minimalist and spacious feel.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dynamic hero text, which cycles through different words to convey its message, combined with an asymmetrical, high-contrast layout for content presentation. This creates an immediate, engaging, and memorable brand statement that feels both modern and editorial.
